question: Which of the following is a chemical change?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Burning of wood**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chemical Changes (Chemical Reactions):** Chemical reactions is the** combination of different substances** to transform into a new one.

 
 
• The chemical reaction produces some new substance with new and different physical as well as chemical properties.
 
• **The matter is never created nor destroyed in chemical reactions.**
 
 
 
• **Combustion or burning of wood **is a kind of Chemical Reaction and is an **exothermic process and occurs in presence of O₂.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Expansion of substance on heating: **Substances that expands on heating again gain the original shape after cooling down without any transformation.

 
 
• Thus this change is a **physical change.**
 
 
 
• The same is with **Boiling milk and Crushing of a can.**
